page.layout: One column of running text under the running head. Line-end marks « are printed at the right of each line. No notes in the margins. Page number at top right. Catchword "tur." and signature "m 2" at the foot.
page.notes: The line-end marks « are printed in the right margin of each line; they are reproduced in the running text as printed. The ct ligature in "intelleƈtu" is kept as printed. "&tor" at the start of the line "&tor dicit" is copied as printed; the printed letter may be an abbreviation or a damaged A and is not expanded. The catchword and signature are at the foot, below the last line, and are not part of the running text.
